## fingerprint

```yaml
what_it_is: 'A transformer backbone over image patches/tokens; contributions are usually
  attention, tokenization, or token-grouping changes.

  '
positive_signals:
- patch/token embedding of an image
- self-attention blocks as the backbone
- token grouping, routing, pruning, windowing, or positional-encoding changes
route_elsewhere:
- signal: a ViT teacher trains a smaller model via a distillation loss
  to: TE-TS/knowledge_distillation
- signal: the contribution is only a loss on top of an unchanged backbone
  to: TE-LF/task_specific_loss
worked_examples:
- Vision Transformer (Dosovitskiy et al. 2020)
- Swin Transformer (Liu et al. 2021)
- Random-Swin / random token grouping
```
